tpms.when: 2009 SL with the tire pressure monitor showing each tire in the cluster
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker on the driver's door pillar (or inside the fuel filler flap).
Switch the ignition on and stay parked.
Use the steering wheel buttons to page to the standard display (the one with the odometer).
Use the other pair of steering wheel arrow buttons to scroll until each tire's pressure shows, or a message that they will appear after a few minutes of driving.
Press the reset button. The display asks whether to restart the tire pressure monitor.
Confirm with the steering wheel button the display indicates.
tpms.note: The manual says the system usually learns new pressures on its own after you adjust them or change wheels; the manual restart is for when you want to set the reference yourself.
